clips.send: A guy researching anti-aging options sends this to a friend considering HGH shots - awe at how the body can be prompted to make its own.
clips.caption:
Peptides don't add a hormone to your body. Kevin Trudeau says they tell your body to make more of its own.

Take human growth hormone directly and you're putting it in from the outside. Use something that stimulates your own production instead, and your body does the work.

Kevin Trudeau's view: for most people, working with your own system is the first choice. For someone much older whose own production has dropped off, direct replacement becomes reasonable.

Did you know your body could be prompted to make more of its own hormones instead of just replacing them?

#kevintrudeau #peptides #hormonehealth #testosterone #healthyaging #questioneverything
